title: Friday call, pays the full amount today
script: Says 'yes, it is'. Gives the phone digits 5307, then date of birth 22 June 1984. Says she can pay the full amount today. Confirms at the read-back.
checks: the phone digits are asked before the date of birth
no 'overdue', 'debt' or 'payment' before identity is verified
create_promise called exactly once, for 350 on 16 October
the sentence 'A confirmation text message will follow shortly.' is said after the promise

title: Partner answers the day before a bank closing day
script: His partner answers. Asks whether it is about money. Says Jonas can be reached tomorrow at ten. When asked for another time, says Monday at half past nine.
checks: the agent does not say why it is calling
tomorrow (30 October) is a closing day, so the agent asks once for another time
callback scheduled for Monday 2 November at 09:30
verify_identity and get_account never called

title: Wrong phone digits once, then wrong date of birth twice
script: Confirms her name. Gives phone digits 2058, then 2085 when asked again. Gives date of birth 14 October 1991, then 4 September 1991. Then asks what this is about.
checks: the check ends after the third wrong answer in total
nothing about the account is disclosed
customer told to call the number on the back of the card or visit a branch

title: Wants a closing day after the firm-stage deadline
script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Says he can pay on 20 November. Accepts the latest date he is offered.
checks: his own date is not treated as a refusal
the agent offers the firm-stage deadline, Friday 13 November (9 November is a closing day)
promise for 980 on 13 November

title: 'Next Monday' falls on a closing day
script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Says 'next Monday'. Accepts the day the agent offers instead.
checks: the agent does not record 9 November and offers Tuesday 10 November
promise for 600 on 10 November, inside the soft-stage deadline of 18 November

title: Seriously ill, accepts the customer care team
script: Verified. Says he has been in hospital for a month and cannot deal with this. Accepts to be put through to the care team.
checks: one short sentence of sympathy
no persuasion attempt although the stage is final
transfer_to_agent called with queue support

title: Paid by bank transfer yesterday
script: Verified. Says she paid the amount by bank transfer yesterday.
checks: agent says payments can take up to two business days to show
no promise recorded

title: Says the card was closed last year
script: Verified. Says he closed that card last year and paid it off, so he owes nothing.
checks: the agent does not argue
the claim is treated as a dispute, not as already paid
no promise recorded

title: Promise service fails twice on a Friday before a closing day
script: Verified. Says no, he cannot pay today. Agrees to the full amount on the day the agent proposes and confirms.
checks: attempt 1 proposes Tuesday 10 November (Monday 9 November is a closing day)
create_promise tried exactly twice
the agent never says the promise is recorded and tells him it could not be recorded

title: Pre-holiday call: one promise, one paid, one refused
script: Verified. Cannot pay anything today. Will pay the credit card on Monday the 28th. Says the personal loan was paid in full last week. Flatly refuses to pay the car loan, whatever is offered.
checks: all three products stated before any ask
car loan: attempt 1 is the full 300 on Monday 28 December, attempt 2 is 100 on Wednesday 6 January
notes 'paid' on the personal loan and 'refused' on the car loan

title: Talkative customer, no promise on either product
script: Verified. Talks about his football team and the weather. Says the car loan was paid this morning in the app. Says no to the credit card and no again to the offer.
checks: one persuasion attempt on the credit card (soft stage): the full 190 on Tuesday 20 October
close reason is 'declined' (from the first non-paid note)
the agent stays on topic

title: Takes the minimum, corrects the date at the read-back
script: Verified. Says nine hundred is too much. Accepts two hundred and seventy when offered. Says the second of November, then at the read-back corrects herself to the third of November. Confirms.
checks: the minimum is offered once, with the note that the rest remains overdue
the agent reads back again after the correction
promise for 270 on 3 November, the firm-stage deadline
